title: Fast path follows decision risk rather than change type
context: A fix-only shortcut excluded fully understood toolchain upgrades even when no product or architecture decision remained. The delivery gate should protect unresolved decisions rather than classify work by its commit type or dependency version.
decision: Use Fast path for clearly specified, bounded work that needs no new product or architecture decision and can be accepted independently in one pull request. The shortcut removes Change-page gates, not verification or independent review. WORKFLOW.md owns the current eligibility and escalation rules.
consequences: A major dependency version alone neither grants nor denies Fast-path eligibility.
